name: India Shelter Finance Corporation Limited
summary: India Shelter Finance Corporation Limited operates as a housing finance company in India. The company offers home, purchase and home construction, and home renovation loan, as well as loan against property. It also provides secured retail home loans and home equity loans. The company was formerly known as Satyaprakash Housing Finance India Limited and changed its name to India Shelter Finance Corporation Limited in March 2010. India Shelter Finance Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.
